scenes.title: The Struggle
scenes.content: Close-up shot of a person lying on a couch, looking exhausted in a dimly lit, cozy room. The camera zooms in on their face as they sigh deeply, rubbing their temples. They look at a fitness app on their phone, then back at the couch, hesitating. Soft, relaxing ASMR sounds of rustling fabric and gentle tapping play in the background.
scenes.onscreen_text: Ugh, I really don't feel like working out today...

scenes.title: The Transformation
scenes.content: Quick cut to the same person in workout clothes, standing in a bright, sunny gym. The camera follows them as they start exercising, with close-ups of their movements. The person starts with light stretching, then moves on to a workout routine. The camera captures the satisfying sounds of weights clinking, sneakers on the treadmill, and deep breaths. Upbeat, motivational music with ASMR workout sounds plays in the background.
scenes.onscreen_text: But I always feel so much better after...

scenes.title: End Screen
scenes.content: Text overlay on a bright, motivational background: 'Workout ASMR: Because you deserve to feel good!' with a call-to-action to like, share, and follow for more.
scenes.onscreen_text: Workout ASMR: Because you deserve to feel good! Like, Share, Follow for more!
